mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO serial_registry (id, enterprise_id, sku_id, normalized_serial, state, owner_warehouse_id, owner_epoch, claim_operation_id, route_bucket, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{skuId}, #{serial}, #{state}, #{warehouseId}, 1, #{operationId}, #{bucket}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT warehouse_id,owner_epoch,shipment_ref FROM serial_shipment WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND normalized_serial=#{serial} AND shipment_ref=#{ref} FOR UPDATE
